basic_details.job_title: DHS Nagapattinam Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Nagapattinam (நாகப்பட்டினம் மாவட்ட நலவாழ்வு சங்கம்) is filling 13 Staff Nurse posts on a contract basis, entirely temporary and on consolidated pay, in the Government Head Quarters Hospitals and the Government Medical College Hospital of the Nagapattinam health district. Applications go to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Nagapattinam, in person or by Speed Post, and must reach the office by 5:00 PM on 4 December 2026. This is a government health society recruitment.

qualification.details: Qualification: Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing (BSC Nursing) from a government or government-recognised private nursing college. Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, is mandatory. Tamil language proficiency required for the post is mandatory. Age: below 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no relaxations. Experience: not specified in the notice. | Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: About District Health Society Nagapattinam
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Nagapattinam is the district health body that issued this notice for the Nagapattinam health district. The notice was released by the District Collector, Thiru K.J. Praveen Kumar, I.A.S., and published by the Public Relations Office, Nagapattinam. The posts are newly created and entirely temporary, filled on consolidated pay.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send or hand in the completed application, with copies of the relevant documents, to: Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Nagapattinam. The notice prints no PIN code. Applications are accepted in person or by Speed Post. The application form can be downloaded from the website nagapattinam.nic.in. The completed form with copies of the relevant documents must be submitted at the District Health Society office by 5:00 PM on 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing (BSC Nursing) from a government or government-recognised private nursing college. Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, is mandatory. Tamil language proficiency required for the post is mandatory. Age: below 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no relaxations. Experience: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.pay: Consolidated pay; amount not specified in the notice

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Completed application form. Copies of the relevant supporting documents (the notice does not list them individually).

rows.event: Last date for submission of applications

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse posts are vacant in Nagapattinam?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacant Staff Nurse posts, to be filled on a contract, temporary basis in the Government Medical College Hospital and Government Head Quarters Hospitals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Completed applications must be submitted at the District Health Society office by 5:00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: A Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a government or government-recognised private nursing college is required, along with Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 50 years, as the notice words it.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the filled form with copies of the relevant documents in person or by Speed Post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, Nagapattinam.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The form can be downloaded from the website nagapattinam.nic.in.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes the posts as entirely temporary, contract posts on consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q8. Is Tamil knowledge required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice makes Tamil language proficiency required for the post mandatory.
